what: Pressing a tab makes the pill behind it overshoot the new cell by distance × .08 (6~16px) (.35s power3.out) and return to place (.25s power2.inOut). Meanwhile it squashes vertically to .78 (.15s) and springs back with back.out(2.5) over .45s. If there is a panel, the card squashes sideways to .96×1.02 and shifts 10px, then returns over .45s with back.out(2). The current panel shifts 35px and disappears in .2s, the new panel enters from 35px on the opposite side in .3s, and the panel height fits the new panel in .3s. Behind the hovered cell a faint shadow pill follows in .3s and turns off in .2s when the pointer leaves the row. Left/right arrows, Home and End also move the selection

options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Tab button (aria-selected=true is the first cell)
options.[data-fx-part=pill]: Current cell pill — inside the tab row (positioned parent)
options.[data-fx-part=ghost]: (If present) Faint pill behind the hovered cell
options.[data-fx-part=panes] > [data-fx-part=pan: (if present) a panel per tab — the panel group’s height changes
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: (If present) Card that squashes when switching panels
options.--fx-pill · --fx-ghost · --fx-on · --fx-: Pill color · shadow pill color · selected tab text color · corners
